author: Ifmyante
text:
Every question is perfectly fine to ask; it can very often point many in the right direction.

Not every question should be answered though, as it's possible to give away our entire methodology on one chart!

So please don't think of me as mean for not answering some questions. We just need to be cautious.

I have, of course, already shown every single place I look to trade, so
you may consider your question answered many times over

author: Ifmyante
text:
I really wouldn't want to start selling before 1.3316.

I see your last entry is far bigger than your previous, so it might be very painful to see it go that far.

I only have history back there in the weekly and above, but our high looks like it hit a good place to bounce.

Price can certainly retrace before 1.3316, and retrace deeply, getting all your trades into profit.

But can you take the risk that it won't?

If your account is being greatly diminished by these trades, then I'd
say take some or all of your positions off, either now, or on a revisit
to 1.2912, should it get there soon.

Cutting your losses will help you breathe again, and hopefully force you to make a trade plan and stick to it

author: Rdk123
text:
Brilliant QM level in weekly supply, surely these charts with your trades on are the best lessons any of us can take.

You know, Through all of this learning malarkey I've reached a point
where I'm more in awe of the attributes that aren't discussed very much
instead of the ability to read a chart well. Patience and discipline,
trading your plan and planning your trade with no deviation, I have the
utmost respect for you as the qualities you exhibit to execute these
trades are second to none, whether it be through your experience gained
or just sitting on your hands (which I'm sure everyone here has actually
 done at one point), many people would have panicked and chased that
trade only to see it hit the level where your order was (and probably
get their stop hit as they've moved it to BE).

On a slightly different subject, I'm wondering whether you have a TF you
 prefer to stick to for trading, while still doing your top down
analysis? This is something I'm really looking in to as it's easy to get
 lost going up and down, I feel like 5 & 1 min should be kept for
pinpointing our entries unless we are all over our top down analysis and
 know exactly where price is heading and want to scalp the hell out of
it.

Again, thank you for your charts, the entry and exit prices you show us are our best lesson.

In the chart below, I've put the reason I believe you took the trade, I
remember you've always said to keep it simple so I believe this is as
simple as the QM level in weekly supply.

If I wanted to go in to more detail and get into what I believe your
train of thought is then I'd say (knowing you were at the QM level in
weekly supply) you saw the engulf lower yesterday and waited patiently
for price to FO to the last remaining orders above the high, knowing
there would also be plenty of stops there for the IT's to take against
their sells.

I'm not 100% but I feel like we could be heading for the blue box at least, eventually, maybe even the 119.400 area.

Have a good weekend IF, and thanks again.

Robbie
